sources.evidence: Pinned official compound-finance/comet commit f766f51583c23acc33b2a7824654ef2029a96804, implementation blob 3490e984d133789aa1afe2e8f7e37a11d2512396. supplyFrom forwards caller identity as the account/caller and passes caller-selected from, dst, asset, and amount into supplyInternal (implementation lines 729–731); the shared path enforces pause and hasPermission(from, msg.sender), and permits the base asset or collateral through fixed internal token branches (737–749). withdrawFrom similarly passes caller identity plus caller-selected src, to, asset, and amount into withdrawInternal (951–953), which enforces pause and hasPermission(src, msg.sender) and uses the fixed base-asset/collateral branches (959–971). Delegated Comet permission may be required; this platform admission does not create it or impose a from/src-to-caller restriction.
